evidence:
REACHABILITY. Runtime: environment/Dockerfile installs node:22 + express@5.1.0 + better-sqlite3@12.4.1 under NODE_PATH, matching instruction.md:13 ('Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages') and integration.md:3-4; the verifier tests/Dockerfile installs the same two packages, and test.sh:104-111 launches with PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH exactly as hireops_rules.md:198-202 discloses (cwd-independence, possible writable copy, uid 65534). Sessions, SSE/polling, SQLite and paging need only Node built-ins plus these packages. Network is public (task.toml network_mode='public'; SKILL.md delivery profile); no requirement depends on network (CDN optional, instruction.md:13). Seed: every data-dependent requirement is backed by seed_data.json - 10 users with exactly the roles listed in instruction.md:17; 3 jobs with manager_id and interview_limit (3/2/3); 16 applications with stage+position, and APP-301 with rejected_from/reject_reason; candidate_status_labels and thread_page_size=30 (hireops_rules.md:208-209); APP-101 has 120 messages in created_at order (30 per page -> 30,60,90,120); read markers make Lena's unread = 1 (APP-301: 3 messages, read_count 2, 3rd by USR-REC3), matching functional protocol Z; Noor read 119/120 with #120 her own; seeded Platform Engineer order Applied Greta, Ade, Marco / Screen Priya, Samuel and Noor's note match protocol Z and hro_restart. Message records carry no ids, covered by hireops_rules.md:38 'Identifiers are generated by the workspace'. Every account in app_context.md is in the seed; candidate accounts link by email (rules:34-36). A golden implementing the brief exists (raw-evidence-index scripted golden run; not a judge run).

UNAMBIGUITY - each graded demand checked against public text: one-stage moves/skips (rules:47-48), reject with non-blank reason and not from Hired (49), reopen only to rejected-from with reason cleared (51), arrival at bottom (58), reorder controls (59), Interview capacity incl. reorder and freed place (63-65), role matrix incl. HM reopen only from Interview/Offer (69-73), 409 stale with 'by whom' (77-80), optimistic put-back with reason and focus (84-85), bulk board-order arrival and all-or-none with places counted for the set (89-92), undo semantics incl. reason restore, conflicts (moved/re-ordered/rejected/reopened by anyone), overfill, note not counting, undo-once and superseded by a later move (96-100), activity lines/newest first/job filter/refusals add none (110-113), 15 s live updates preserving typing/focus/open card/conversation/scroll (117-123), Enter/Shift+Enter/blank refusal/failed send (138-140), 30-message paging with remaining count and anchored place (144-147), per-person unread incl. own messages and send-as-read (151-160), seen rules incl. observer never counts and the job's HM (164-166), drafts per person/conversation/browser surviving navigation/reload/session end with sign-in prompt (170-175), candidate wording and no auto-open (179-190), candidate data exclusions (192-194), 401/403/404 statuses (21-23), places a whole number 1..50 and HM chosen from HM accounts (27-29), email validity and case-insensitive per-job duplicate shown at the field (31-36). I traced functional protocols B steps 1-15 and L on the stated rules: every expected outcome (B4 Y,W,X below V; B5 Y,W,X,Z,A2; B12 undo of A2 proceeds after Mei re-orders Y, which is at the top of Screen so only Y/W swap and A2 is untouched; B13 A2,V; L undo of E refused at 2/2 then allowed) follows uniquely from the public rules. Whether reopen/reject/reorder count as 'moves' for undo is never discriminative in the protocols (the undone action is always a stage move or the reopening; every later attempt is refused under either reading).

CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES TRIED: (a) no version field but 'from-stage' freshness -> still refuses protocol C replay; (b) an app bumping A2's version when a neighbour is re-ordered would refuse the B12 undo, but rules:77 says the version changes when the card moves and rules:98 limits conflicts to 'those cards', so that is a nonconforming reading, not a second reasonable one; (c) an app hiding the full-Interview move control: see observation 1. BROKEN APP TRIED: client-only capacity/role checks fail the required replays (L, B8, R), and browser-only drafts/unread fail independent-context reads; the brief clearly requires server enforcement (rules:21-23, 53, 63).

NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATIONS (no defect found): (1) P3 latent: a UI that hides or disables the Screen->Interview control when Interview is full, with no reason shown, gives hro_refused_put_back (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml) nothing to observe, while functional prompt.md:23 says 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice'. The public brief resolves this ('If a move is refused, put the card back where it really is and tell me why', instruction.md:3; rules:84-85), and the criterion accepts 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card', so a silent hide is a nonconforming reading; the owner may still want hro_refused_put_back to say explicitly how a hidden or disabled control is judged. (2) GET /api/health must answer without a session while rules:21 says a sessionless caller 'reads and writes nothing: 401'; the only reasonable reading is workspace data, and test.sh probe_ready accepts any HTTP response, so no grading impact. (3) People with no seeded read marker have no explicit default (natural reading: nothing read); no criterion grades a seeded count other than Lena's. (4) The Internal Quality Checks annotation for #6 says 'no network', which conflicts with the public sheet and the SKILL.md delivery profile ('Network is public'); the current profile governs, and no requirement here depends on network either way. Missing evidence: no configured judge run, Oracle or model score; this verdict rests on source reading plus the golden's existence, which is the relevant evidence for instruction achievability and is not a claim about scores.
